name: io.github.trobichaux/m365-service-comms-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for the Microsoft Graph Service Communications API. Exposes M365 service health and Message Center posts to AI agents using delegated authentication.

environment_variables.name: M365_CLIENT_ID
environment_variables.description: Microsoft Entra app-registration client GUID with ServiceHealth.Read.All and ServiceMessage.Read.All delegated permissions admin-consented.

environment_variables.name: M365_AUTH_DEVICE_CODE
environment_variables.description: Set to 1 to force device-code OAuth flow (headless/SSH).
